title: kira-spliceqc: deterministic, explainable splicing QC for single-cell RNA-seq
description: Per-cell splicing quality control from gene counts (expression signatures), spliced/unspliced layers (unspliced fraction with Wilson intervals, intron retention index) and STARsolo junction matrices (cryptic 3' splice-site usage, exon skipping, splice-site shift), with stratified depth-corrected references, FDR-calibrated flags, a simulation-based validation suite and a public benchmark package.
